# Fitting brake pads

Fit the pads **in pairs**, *never* one side alone. See the [next step](https://shop.example/guide/brakes/next.html) or the [index](https://shop.example/index.html).\
Torque to 30 Nm.

## What you need

- A jack
- Two new pads
  3. front
  4. rear

```python
def torque(nm):
    return nm * 1.0
```

Run `check()` after.

> Brakes save lives.
>
> Check them yearly.

Torque by axle

| Axle | Nm \| range |
|---|---|
| Front | 30 |
| Rear: see manual |  |
